messages:
eric: Kickoff — Bankernext POC. Need to lock top 3 user journeys, endpoints, and pass/fail metrics by EOD Wed. Also legal will require the security questionnaire answered. @maya you said you'd own prompts/evals?

maya: Yep — I'll draft 5 prompt families + a scoring rubric. Will need sample rows (anonymized) for edge cases. ETA Tue noon.

sanjay: Quick check on perf targets: client expects p50 <300ms and p95 <800ms for short queries. Is that realistic on Hosted, or should we recommend Dedicated?

leo: Dedicated can meet p95 ~500ms at their expected QPS for 1k-1.5k token average. Hosted is variable; with routing policies we can hit p95 ~700-900ms depending on model. Recommend Dedicated for SLA-critical flows.

eric: Noted. For success criteria propose: (1) accuracy >= 85% on a 200-prompt eval set, (2) latency p95 <= 750ms, (3) no critical findings in security scan, (4) integration smoke tests pass (auth + sample traffic). Agree?

alisa: On security: they want confirmation of data residency + KMS/HSM options and SSO (SAML). I'll start the questionnaire now — need vendor contact and their SOC2 scope. @eric please share the contact.

maya: Draft of prompt families I'll include: short answer, multi-turn banking ops, transaction redaction, policy-filter catches, OCR-cleanup. Also create a small adversarial set for hallucination checks.

eric: Sharing contact: jane.doe@bankernext.com (security lead). Also note the POC timeline constraint: they want meaningful results in 3 weeks. Can we compress eval cadence?

leo: We can do a 2-week rapid loop if they accept limited traffic and agreed sampling. Week 1: integration + baseline eval. Week 2: tuning + final eval.

maya: I'll set up an eval dashboard and share a link for live runs. Example eval config I'll use: 
```
{
  "eval_sets": ["short-q","multi-turn","redaction"],
  "metrics": ["precision","recall","exact_match","latency_p95"]
}
```

sanjay: Pricing question from procurement: if we recommend Dedicated, what's the minimum commit and estimated monthly cost for their QPS? Need a rough number to include in the PoC SOW.

eric: Sales asks for a ballpark today — aim for a not-to-exceed figure. @leo can you draft a 3-month and 12-month cost estimate with burst strategy?

leo: I'll draft 3- and 12-months with autoscale/burst. Rough numbers: 3-mo pilot ~$28k/mo, 12-mo committed ~$18k/mo equivalent (discounted). I'll put details in the SOW.

security-bot: Security questionnaire assigned to alisa. Deadline requested: 5 business days.

deploy-bot: FYI — canary deploy of the eval harness scheduled Wed 03:00 UTC (no downtime expected).

eric: Next steps / owners: (1) maya — prompts & eval harness (due Tue noon). (2) alisa — security questionnaire + vendor comms (start today). (3) leo — cost estimates & Dedicated feasibility (by EOD Wed). (4) sanjay — perf acceptance criteria + smoke test plan. I'll draft the SOW with these inputs and circulate for sign-off.

maya: I'll upload sample prompts and a SHARE link once harness is live.

alisa: Starting the questionnaire — will ping Jane for SOC2 scope and SSO SAML metadata.

leo: Working on cost + infra plan, will include fallback routing options for Hosted vs Dedicated.

eric: Thanks all — please post updates in this thread. If anyone hits a blocker, call it out and we'll escalate to Solutions Eng. :thumbsup:
